text: FOUND BY THE CHIEF while auditing ADR 0003 migration sites; traced before rating. TWO SITES IN ONE FUNCTION, induce.scala. (A) line 479, the catch-all in the specificity classifier: 'case _ => Estimate.observed(0.0)'. The scrutinee is 'classes.getOrElse(u.id, UnitClass.Uninterpretable)', so the default for a unit we NEVER CLASSIFIED is Uninterpretable, which falls to the catch-all and publishes Estimate.observed(0.0). Two distinct conditions - we classified it as uninterpretable, and we never classified it at all - are collapsed, and BOTH are published as a measurement. (B) line 536, 'result.specificity.getOrElse(d.id, Estimate.observed(0.0))': the map is built with flatMap over 'graph.byId.get(d.sourceUnit)', so a detail whose source unit is absent from the graph produces no entry and is then defaulted to an observed zero. Absence there is a pipeline condition, not a participant property. WHY THIS IS THE ESTIMAND CLASS AND NOT A MODELLING CHOICE: observed(0.0) asserts we measured the detail and found it maximally unspecific. The truth in both cases is that we do not know. The vocabulary to say so already exists in this codebase - Estimate.Missing with a reason - and neither site uses it. SIGN AND CORRELATION, the reason this is P1 rather than P3: 0.0 is the WORST specificity score, and units we cannot classify or cannot locate in the graph are disproportionately the vaguer, sparser recalls - exactly the participant property a study compares. The error therefore runs one way and correlates with the comparison. This is the identical argument RecallSignature's own Scaladoc already makes for holding unrankedMass apart from attributed external mass; the doctrine is written down in this repo and this site predates it. CONSEQUENCE TRACED: DetailAssessment.specificity is a public field of a published per-detail record - it is library output, so the wrong number reaches a consumer whether or not an internal aggregator sums it today. Fix direction: Estimate.Missing with a reason distinguishing 'unclassified' from 'classified uninterpretable' from 'source unit absent from graph'; do NOT collapse them, and do not substitute a neutral constant.
